purpose: A sentence of what a picture shows, written by a model (user 2026-11-10: Florence-2 as the second AI engine beside SigLIP: it names what it sees without a vocabulary), as a plug-in program. Version 2 (docs/102 step 5): the request carries the pictures themselves and names the model; the program finds the model in the AI catalog of the computer it runs on. Nothing falls back to another engine.
transport: The JSON lines of qnc.module.plugin-process: the application's hello, the plug-in's ready, then one request at a time.

captions.body: { model, pictures: [jpeg] }: model is a model's name (its file or folder name); each picture is a JPEG as base64
captions.ok: { captions: [text] }: one English sentence or a few a picture, in the order given

rules: At most 8 pictures a request. The plug-in reads no file of the application and writes nothing. A picture it cannot read, or a model not in its computer's AI catalog, is an error, never a guess.
acceptance: crates/qnc-shot-caption-run/examples/caption_files.rs (the captions of pictures given, only read).
